edge_cases.mitigation: handle under contracted seasonal mechanics, bill only what remains real, mark the flag as rhythm rather than defection, and calendar the spring re-ramp conversation

edge_cases.description: An office employee takes their extension home permanently on a softphone without telling anyone
edge_cases.trigger: an undisclosed remote user discovered during a review or fault
edge_cases.mitigation: register the user's actual dispatchable location immediately, add a remote-user question to every review agenda, and verify current requirements for off-premises users with the platform's E911 workflow

edge_cases.description: One account's staff keeps calling for the same basic changes its trained admin was shown how to make, drowning support hours
edge_cases.trigger: persistent load outlier resistant to self-service
edge_cases.mitigation: document the load from the time log, re-offer training once, then run the honest conversation - scope reset against the charter or a re-price under contracted mechanics - instead of silent absorption

edge_cases.description: A multi-day platform outage triggers SLA credit exposure across the entire book at once
edge_cases.trigger: prolonged upstream failure touching every account
edge_cases.mitigation: compute credits uniformly from recorded terms and apply them unprompted, claim the operator's own credits under the upstream agreement, and file the incident as first-class evidence in the platform log

edge_cases.description: During a Wi-Fi cross-sell conversation the customer asks the operator to also take over their POS system and door locks
edge_cases.trigger: adjacency request beyond genuine delivery capability
edge_cases.mitigation: decline what cannot be delivered and supported, refer to a trusted specialist, and disclose any broker arrangement on what is kept - the capability limit is not negotiable by enthusiasm

edge_cases.description: The platform sunsets a feature - legacy fax bridging - that several dental and motel accounts quietly depend on
edge_cases.trigger: upstream feature retirement with dependent accounts
edge_cases.mitigation: inventory dependent accounts from feature-usage records, plan and quote replacements before the retirement date, and disclose the timeline early rather than letting customers discover the loss

workflow.action: Frame the recurring stage and the book's four jobs
workflow.description: Fix what the book is, the margin mechanism with named input sources, and the boundaries against the sales and deployment stages
workflow.gate: the keep-support-bill-grow jobs, the margin mechanism, and both sibling-stage boundaries are stated in writing

workflow.action: Take the intake handoff for every account entering service
workflow.description: Collect the as-built record and push gaps back to deployment while the install is warm
workflow.gate: call flows, devices, credentials, port evidence, E911 entries, support promise, and contacts present, or gaps logged back with dates

workflow.description: Draw the bundled-versus-billable line and state only hours and response bands the crew can staff
workflow.gate: the charter reconciles line by line against the sold support promise and every stated band is staffable

workflow.action: Stand up triage and escalation discipline
workflow.description: Build the layer ladder with symptom signatures, the platform-status short-circuit, the evidence checklist, and the escalation packet format
workflow.artifact: triage runbook with escalation packet format
workflow.gate: symptom-to-layer mappings, the evidence checklist, and the packet contents exist and open with the platform-status check

workflow.action: Stand up the outage response routine
workflow.description: Write detection sources, blast-radius verification, failover activation steps per account, the communication cadence, and the credit procedure
workflow.gate: detection, verification, failover, cadence wording, and the recorded-terms credit procedure are all written before the first incident needs them

workflow.description: Couple the dispatchable-location record action to every move-add-change ticket and set the current-requirements verification cadence
workflow.gate: every ticket type carries its E911 action, the no-close-without-record rule is in force, and the verification cadence is dated

workflow.description: Walk invoices against seat and feature records, label every fee honestly, and hold tax treatment to the professionally verified channel-model position
workflow.gate: invoices match reality, no uncontracted or padded fee line exists, and the tax treatment matches the verified position

workflow.action: Build and maintain the commercial register
workflow.description: Record term dates, notice windows, rate mechanics, hardware ownership, and the SLA basis for every account
workflow.gate: every active account has a complete entry and no promise on file exceeds the upstream SLA basis

workflow.action: Instrument health signals and the save and exit motions
workflow.description: Write the signal catalog, open the flag log with owners and dates, and attach the save playbook and the clean-exit checklist
workflow.artifact: health flag log with save and offboarding playbooks attached
workflow.gate: signals are defined with examples, every open flag carries owner and next action, and both playbooks are written

workflow.action: Compute book economics and tier the book
workflow.description: Build the margin worksheet from named source records, decompose MRR motion, and derive the tier map with uniform floors
workflow.artifact: book margin worksheet and tier map
workflow.gate: every input traces to its source record, MRR motion splits four ways, and the floor check passes on every tier

workflow.action: Run the review and expansion loop
workflow.description: Hold tier-cadenced reviews from each account's own record and route findings to seat, feature, and cross-sell motions inside the boundary
workflow.artifact: per-account review briefs with routed findings
workflow.gate: each review's agenda is record-driven and closes on one of the four honest outputs with a next action

workflow.action: Close the quarter at the book gate
workflow.description: Walk every account against the definition-of-done and convert flags, windows, findings, outliers, and the platform file into dated, owned decisions
workflow.gate: every account shows the full definition-of-done or a written exception, and every decision carries an owner and a date

dominance_rules.rule: E911 record discipline dominates service speed
dominance_rules.rationale: a wrong dispatchable location surfaces exactly once, during an emergency, and no customer-satisfaction gain compensates for it
dominance_rules.trigger: any move, add, change, or relocation ticket pressured to close before its record action
dominance_rules.action: hold the ticket open until the record is updated or verified; recover speed by parallelizing, never by skipping

dominance_rules.rule: Port-out cooperation dominates the save motion
dominance_rules.rationale: the number is the customer's property and obstruction converts one lost account into a complaint and a circulating story
dominance_rules.trigger: a port-out request arrives during an active save or billing dispute
dominance_rules.action: release accurate porting data promptly; continue persuasion only as an honest parallel conversation and collections on a separate track

dominance_rules.rule: The upstream published SLA dominates any availability language
dominance_rules.rationale: a reseller cannot promise what its platform does not, and unsupported guarantees become liabilities at the first prolonged outage
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer, proposal, or renewal draft seeks stronger uptime language than the verified basis
dominance_rules.action: bound the promise to the upstream published SLA plus the operator's separately stated response commitments, and record the exchange

dominance_rules.rule: Fix-the-fault dominates discount-the-price in every save
dominance_rules.rationale: discounting an unfixed fault pays twice - the margin now and the churn later - because the resentment source remains
dominance_rules.trigger: a save conversation opens while the account has an unresolved fault
dominance_rules.action: resolve and confirm the fault first; only then discuss commercial terms, as mechanism

dominance_rules.rationale: a renewal captured by silence churns with resentment at the first opening and invites dispute-class trouble
dominance_rules.trigger: an auto-renew window approaches on any account
dominance_rules.action: give proactive notice, re-verify seats, and quote at explained current pricing even though it invites shopping

dominance_rules.rule: Review-evidenced need dominates quota in every upsell and cross-sell
dominance_rules.rationale: one quota-driven pitch teaches the customer that every future review hides an agenda, destroying the channel that surfaces honest expansion
dominance_rules.trigger: any expansion or adjacency offer being prepared
dominance_rules.action: require a named finding from the account's own record; without one, no offer is made

dominance_rules.rule: Uniform service floors dominate tier convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: response, E911, billing, and renewal conduct are obligations attached to every sold promise, not privileges of book size
dominance_rules.trigger: pressure to degrade a lower-tier account below the sold promise or a compliance floor
dominance_rules.action: hold the floor; tiers may vary only the attention above it

dominance_rules.rule: Professionally verified tax treatment dominates invoice expediency
dominance_rules.rationale: USF-class and telecom-tax duties differ by channel model and jurisdiction, and a guessed line item compounds into every future invoice
dominance_rules.trigger: uncertainty about a tax, USF-class, or fee line while billing
dominance_rules.action: hold the line item until a qualified telecom accountant or attorney confirms the treatment; never guess or copy a competitor's invoice

dominance_rules.rule: The incident log dominates the latest anecdote in platform decisions
dominance_rules.rationale: stay-or-migrate is a book-scale bet that one terrible week or one smooth month should not decide
dominance_rules.trigger: pressure to flee or recommit to the platform after a single vivid incident
dominance_rules.action: decide from the dated incident log, wholesale terms, and pilot evidence; update the stance only at the book gate

anti_rework_rules.rule: Take the intake handoff before accepting support ownership of an account
anti_rework_rules.prevents: per-fault archaeology across the account's whole service life because the as-built was never captured while the install was warm

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the bundled-versus-billable line before the first out-of-scope request arrives
anti_rework_rules.prevents: precedent-by-accident generosity that must later be clawed back account by resentful account

anti_rework_rules.rule: Rule out the local layers and capture evidence before opening any upstream ticket
anti_rework_rules.prevents: no-trouble-found ping-pong that doubles resolution time and burns escalation credibility for the tickets that matter

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the E911 action inside the same ticket as the move, add, or change
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a book-wide compliance backfill audit after records and reality have silently diverged for months

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile seats before the invoice goes out, not after the dispute comes in
anti_rework_rules.prevents: credit-and-apology cycles that cost more hours and more trust than the reconciliation ever would

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify contract dates in the register before the renewal quarter opens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: concessions negotiated in panic inside an already-closed notice window

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the fault fixed before making any retention concession
anti_rework_rules.prevents: paying twice for the same churn - the discount now and the departure later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tier the book before scheduling the review calendar
anti_rework_rules.prevents: preparing thirty identical reviews where ten deep ones and twenty light ones were what the book actually owed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Pilot the second-platform lane before the incident that forces a migration decision
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a panic migration of the whole book executed on the platform's worst week with an alternative that has never carried a live account

iteration_protocol.trigger: a churn flag opens on any account
iteration_protocol.action: run the save motion fix-first, log the motion order and outcome, and update the account's health state
execute clean offboarding with prompt porting data, close every checklist item including E911 closure, and feed exit findings back into the signal catalog

iteration_protocol.trigger: an E911-relevant change occurs - a move, a remote user, a rule or platform-workflow update
iteration_protocol.action: update and verify the affected dispatchable-location records immediately and re-verify current requirements if the rule class moved

iteration_protocol.trigger: a platform incident, wholesale change, or upstream term change lands
iteration_protocol.action: log it, recompute affected margins, refresh the migration costing, and set the stance at the next gate

iteration_protocol.trigger: the ticket log shows a repeat-cause pattern
iteration_protocol.action: run root-cause analysis, ship the permanent fix or self-service artifact, and update the triage runbook

iteration_protocol.trigger: the renewal quarter opens for a set of accounts
iteration_protocol.action: run their reviews first, then the renewal conversations with re-verified seats and mechanism-explained pricing before any window closes

iteration_protocol.trigger: the book gate finds accounts failing the definition-of-done
iteration_protocol.action: repair the diverged records, re-tier where inputs changed, and close or date every exception

priority_rationale: The frame and the intake record come first because every support, billing, and compliance action operates on what they establish; the support charter precedes triage, escalation, and outage response, which are its live execution in rising blast radius; the E911 loop, billing hygiene, and the commercial register precede retention and renewals because saves, exits, credits, and renewal conduct all read from them; health signals precede saves, exits and tiering; book economics precedes tiering and load control, which set the review cadence; reviews precede seat, feature, and cross-sell motions because honest expansion is review-evidenced; and the book gate composes everything last into dated, owned decisions.
